_meta.title: SMTP relay (no login)
_meta.setup: An internal relay that accepts mail from this host without a login (e.g. Postfix on port 25). Put the allowed recipients into smtp.recipients – addresses or @domain.

description: Send mail through the internal relay
examples: svc mail NAME send --to someone@example.com --subject "Report" --body-file report.txt
notes: confirm: every mail waits for approval (recipients, subject and the start of the text are shown). rw sends without asking – only to smtp.recipients.
